items.title: Ladd McConkey: Four catches in Week 3 loss
items.description:
McConkey secured four of five targets for 66 yards in the Chargers' 24-16 loss to the Bills on Sunday.

items.title: Jared Goff: Tosses two TDs in Week 3 win
items.description:
Goff completed 25 of 32 passes for 269 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Jets. He added six rushing yards on four carries.
